candidate.definition_en: An animal that lives in water, has fins and scales, and breathes through gills, or its flesh eaten as food.
candidate.explanation_ar: حيوان يعيش في الماء له زعانف وخياشيم (سمكة)، أو لحمه الذي يُؤكل كطعام (سمك).

senses.definition_en: An animal that lives in water, has fins and scales, and breathes through gills.
